description: Trusted-source registry for discovering IT and technology-related courses in Kerala.

source_policy.purpose: Define trusted source categories and retrieval priorities.
source_policy.important_rule: This registry is not a fixed list of websites. The web search system may discover additional relevant sources dynamically.
rules: Use official university websites for university programmes and admissions.
Use official institute websites for private training courses.
Use government and recognised skill-development organisations for vocational and professional courses.
Use third-party education platforms mainly for discovery or cross-checking.
If a required field is not available in the retrieved source, report it as unavailable.
Course fees, eligibility, admission dates and availability may change and should be verified from the official source.

official_institute_sources.description: Official websites of private and independent institutes offering IT and technology courses.
official_institute_sources.discovery_method: Discovered dynamically through web search based on the user's course, location and eligibility requirements.
official_institute_sources.verification_rule: Prefer the institute's official course page over third-party listings.

trusted_education_platforms.description: Third-party education and course discovery platforms.
trusted_education_platforms.verification_rule: Important information should be cross-checked against the official institute or university source.
